title: QWOT-scaffolded 14-layer HfO2/Al2O3/SiO2 with fixed thin high-index layers
scientific_hypothesis: Physics-guided QWOT initialization anchored to route_05's best candidate cavity spacers will reduce exploratory distance into non-physical thickness regimes and accelerate convergence toward interference maxima compared to uniform random initialization.
design_principle: Initialize high-index layers (HfO2, Al2O3) at sub-20nm quarter-wave optical thickness for 267nm center wavelength to preserve strong Fresnel reflections. Initialize low-index spacers (SiO2) proportionally to maintain near-resonant phase accumulation. Optimize all thicknesses with gradient-based optimizer from this scaffold.
proposed_topology: 14-layer sequence: Air | HfO2 | Al2O3 | SiO2 | HfO2 | Al2O3 | SiO2 | HfO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | Al2O3 | SiO2 | HfO2 | Al2O3 | SiO2 | Substrate
design_variables: High-index layers fixed at 15-20nm during initialization phase
soft_objectives: Minimize mean transmittance in 300-700nm visible band
Minimize mean transmittance in 700-1100nm NIR band
manufacturing_considerations: Sub-20nm high-index layers require precise deposition control
HfO2 may form uneven surfaces during evaporation per evidence
theory_basis: Quarter-wave optical thickness principle for constructive/destructive interference
Transfer-matrix method for multilayer thin-film optics
expected_advantages: Faster convergence than uniform random initialization
Reduced risk of optimizer exploring non-physical thickness regimes
Preserves route_05's verified material system while improving initialization
known_risks: HfO2 surface inhomogeneity may limit reproducibility
Fixed thin layers may constrain optimizer from finding better configurations
14-layer count may be insufficient for broad visible/NIR blocking
execution_request_english: Optimize a 14-layer dielectric stack on fused silica substrate for solar-blind UV filtering. Materials: HfO2 (high-index), Al2O3 (medium-index), SiO2 (low-index). Layer sequence from air: HfO2, Al2O3, SiO2, HfO2, Al2O3, SiO2, HfO2, HfO2, SiO2, Al2O3, SiO2, HfO2, Al2O3, SiO2. Initialize high-index layers at 15-20nm QWOT for 267nm center wavelength. Initialize low-index SiO2 spacers at quarter-wave optical thickness for 267nm. Optimize all 14 thicknesses using gradient-based optimizer with bounds 10-150nm. Evaluate transmittance at normal incidence across 255-280nm (passband), 300-700nm (visible stopband), and 700-1100nm (NIR stopband). Score candidates by mean passband transmittance minus mean stopband transmittance. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 255-280 nm, 300-700 nm, 700-1100 nm. soft objectives: High transmittance in 255–280 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: Transmittance in 300–700 nm; Transmittance in 700–1100 nm. manufacturing constraints: Maximum 30 layers; No metal layers; Only conventional depositable inorganic dielectric materials.
revision_reason: Replace uniform random initialization with physics-guided QWOT scaffold per feedback directive. Fix sub-20nm high-index layers during initialization to preserve strong Fresnel reflections. Perturb thick low-index spacers proportionally to maintain near-resonant phase accumulation.
